title: Scandinavian UFOs come down only in water

tellings.quote:
and it is important it is not a single
object has crashed on land in Sweden or
Norway

plain: In the wave of strange sightings over Sweden and Norway in 1946, not a single object came down on land: they all came down in water. The Swedish UFO researcher Clas Svahn tells Michels this, stressing that "it is important", without naming a source here. If true, the pattern would be a clue to what the objects were and why none was ever recovered on land.
